description: This file defines the core Intermediate Representation (IR) structures for the Torch JIT compiler, including classes for Graph, Node, Value, and Block, as well as utility functions, operator sets, and schema mappings used in the IR.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents a value in the IR, which can be an input or output of a node, including type information and usage details.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Base class for IR nodes representing computations, with methods for manipulating inputs, outputs, attributes, and control flow.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Represents a list of nodes, used for structured control flow constructs within a graph.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Represents a computation graph, containing nodes, values, and subgraphs, with methods for construction and analysis.

classes.name: Use
classes.description: Represents a use of a value by a node, including the user node and the input offset.

classes.name: OperatorSet
classes.description: Manages a set of operators identified by their signatures.

classes.name: OperatorMap
classes.description: Template class mapping operators to associated data, supporting insertion, lookup, and erasure.

classes.name: FunctionSchemaMap
classes.description: Template class mapping function schemas to associated data, supporting insertion, lookup, and erasure.

classes.name: ProfileOp
classes.description: Node for profiling, executing a callback during graph execution.

classes.name: ProfileIValueOp
classes.description: Node for profiling IValues, executing a callback during graph execution.

classes.name: PythonOp
classes.description: Abstract base class for Python functions integrated into the IR.

methods.name: cloneFrom
methods.description: Copies properties from another node or value.

methods.name: replaceAllUsesWith
methods.description: Replaces all uses of this value with another value.

methods.name: addInput
methods.description: Adds an input value to a node.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new node of a specified kind within a graph.

methods.name: insertConstant
methods.description: Inserts a constant value into the graph.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a node into the graph based on a schema and arguments.
